# ScaleMesh <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Meshes](Blitz3D-Meshes)

</div>


```blitzbasic
ScaleMesh:Void mesh:Int32, x_scale:Float32, y_scale:Float32, z_scale:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mesh` | In | Int32 | required | Mesh handle. |
| `x_scale` | In | Float32 | required | Factor along X. |
| `y_scale` | In | Float32 | required | Factor along Y. |
| `z_scale` | In | Float32 | required | Factor along Z. |

## Description

Multiplies the coordinates of every vertex by a factor per axis, permanently, around the origin. Unlike [ScaleEntity](ScaleEntity) it changes the mesh itself, so its size from [MeshWidth](MeshWidth) and friends changes too. A negative factor mirrors the mesh, which also turns its triangles inside out, so follow it with [FlipMesh](FlipMesh).
